data.body: **[P1] Route root payload failures through invocation completion handling.** Output serialization occurs after the branch that classifies retryable payload failures, so an offload exception makes the callback exceptional and skips `onInvocationEnd`; permanent failures also never become a `FAILED` output. Error-data offloading can similarly throw after `FAILED` was already emitted. Handle both paths centrally: report `RETRYING` and rethrow retryable failures, and convert permanent failures to a non-offloaded failure output. Add root-output/error-data lifecycle tests.
